CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE SPECIALTY CONSULT NOTE V1
Patient: Daniel Harris | MRN: PAT-60018 | DOB: 1961-02-03 | Gender: Male | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0018
Encounter Date: 2025-06-17 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-06-19 | Provider: Dr. Marcus Vance, DO
REASON FOR CONSULTATION
Consult requested by primary medical team regarding refractory clinical optimization and therapeutic titration. Consultant
team: Cardiovascular Medicine Consult Service.
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE: We were asked to evaluate patient Daniel Harris, who was admitted three
days ago with complex multisystem decompensation. On initial presentation, initial biomarker profiling revealed calcium of
9.46 mg/dL. Subsequent evaluation demonstrated that serum white blood cell count was 2.8 10*3/uL (LOW). Prior
outpatient regimens had proven insufficient to achieve therapeutic stability.
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY: During inpatient specialty evaluation, the consultant team adjusted pharmacological
therapy. The patient was initiated on Amlodipine 2.5 mg PO every morning. Following this intervention, trajectory
assessment showed total cholesterol of 167.7 mg/dL. Clinical response has been favorable with marked improvement in
objective metabolic parameters.
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS: The specialty team recommends the following maintenance
regimen: continue Metoprolol 25 mg PO twice daily; and titrate Amoxicillin 500 mg by mouth three times daily for 7 days.
Avoid NSAIDs and nephrotoxic exposures.
CONSULTANT ASSESSMENT & SPECIALTY PLAN
The patient is stabilized and appropriate for transfer to the regular step-down floor. Re-evaluate laboratory markers in 48
hours. Thank you for this interesting consultation.
